quotes.summary_phrase: Moussa Diabate on sustaining leads and team consistency
quotes.excerpt: trying to figure out how to sustain our lead
quotes.quote: Trying to figure out how to sustain our lead. I don't think any other team that we played are better than us. I think that we proved that we can make those leads. It's not like we just can't make them, we just got to learn how to sustain it. That's been the main talks for the past three, four games, and now we just got to figure out a way to apply it.
